marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF510B ratchet features a 1/2 and 3/8 in square drive and offers a torque rating of 75 ft-lb, with a speed rating of 0-300 RPM. This cordless tool has a sealed head design and a glass-filled nylon tool housing, and includes an integrated LED light for improved visibility. The ratchet also includes a trigger lock to prevent accidental tool activation and forward and reverse functionality.
